body:
As @olance pointed out, we shouldn't advocate for necessarily normalizing data with a custom backend. The previous example fetched a user's profile based on its ID retrieved from Algolia.

This new example takes advantage of the real-time data on a custom server that Algolia can't always provide: we store the availability of a product on Algolia but retrieve the exact remaining stock on the server.

🔗 [**Link to the section**](https://deploy-preview-2957--algolia-instantsearch.netlify.com/v2/guides/custom-backend.html#going-further-enriching-data-from-the-backend)
